== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Robert McCaughern. The 1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory lists Robert McCaughern, farmer, Lisnagaver in the neighbourhood section for Rasharkin. It is a useful later locality lead because Lisnagaver is the Glasgow family's documented townland and the directory places a McCaughern farmer there after the 1851 and 1901–1911 census evidence.<ref>1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory, Rasharkin; [https://lennonwylie.co.uk/PT191214.htm record].</ref> It does not identify Robert's age, parents or relationship to Mary Glasgow, and it must not be merged with any other Robert McCaughern without the underlying valuation, census or civil records. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns Robert McCaughern. The original 1911 Lisnagaver return identifies Robert McCaughern, 54, farmer, with wife Mary Anne, 58; married 28 years, both Antrim-born Church of Ireland. The occupation and exact locality strongly identify the 1912 directory farmer. His parents are not stated.<ref>1911 Lisnagaver, Robert McCaughern household; [https://api-census.nationalarchives.ie/census/image/nai001389352.pdf record].</ref> The identification remains uncertain.
